title: plan-campaign input
description: One operator's campaign state: its ledger entries, the measured noise threshold, the target attainment and the routes the playbooks still hold open. `entries` items are the subset of schemas/ledger-entry.schema.json this decision consumes; the shape is inlined because contracts may not reference another file.

entries.description: This operator's ledger entries, oldest first. Read them from ledger/experiments.jsonl; never edit them.

noise_threshold.description: Measured A/A noise floor for this operator; a gain inside it is not a gain.

prediction_error_hole.description: |log measured/predicted| above which the hardware model has a hole.

attainment_pct.description: Roofline attainment of the current best version.

start_from.description: Kernel version the next round starts from, e.g. best@exp-0137.

open_routes.description: Playbook items not yet tried for the current signature, with the speedup the hardware model predicts for each.
